pages: - a copy of any correspondence between the IHREC and the Policing Authority with regard to the policing of protests in Coolock (related to possible location of an IP centre there). - a copy of any correspondence between the IHREC and An Garda as above. Both parts of this request to cover the period 1 June 2024 to date.

copies of communications including emails, letters, documents, advice or requests from internal or external individuals or organisations, about the decision to include on the IHREC website under the protected ground of 'gender' the terms 'transgender or nonbinary' either as separate terms or together. As I do not know when the words 'transgender and nonbinary' were added, I cannot specify dates for this.

a copy of any records held by the chief commissioner referring or relating to a suggestion from the Department of Justice about the right to strip citizenship from individuals. For avoidance of doubt, it is the following issue to which I refer: https://www.rte.ie/news/ireland/2025/0410/1506984-legislation- passport-ihrec/
